answers.core: The proposal would change core editor functionality.
answers.workaround:
It is possible to work around it and there are several ways to do so.

- Team members can share their personal editor settings files and keep them in sync that way.
- Onboarding documents cover all the necessary settings and instruct new project members how to apply them.
- Git hooks check the validity of all committed script files and reject them if they don't meet the coding convention.
